Wilee's halal cart chicken over rice.d: Thighs in lemon, oregano, cumin and coriander, griddled and chopped. Turmeric rice, lettuce, white and hot sauce.
Wilee's halal cart chicken over rice.note: Truck 116, Broadway at 116th St. Six dollars.

Messenger fuel bars.d: Oats, dates, peanuts and seeds baked with honey, butter and brown sugar.
Messenger fuel bars.note: From the jar by the window. Goes in the bag.

Dispatch office cookies.d: Chocolate chip, browned butter dough rested overnight, flaky salt.

No-brakes energy smoothie.d: Smoothie of banana, berries, oats, peanut butter and milk, blended thick. Espresso shot 75 cents.

Chinatown pork buns.d: Pork neck marinated overnight in hoisin, honey, soy and five spice, roasted, in steamed buns.
Chinatown pork buns.note: Last stop, Chinatown: from the bakery on Mott, three for 3.00. Not sold at the truck.
